OutboxStatus.description: Outbox item lifecycle. We hold, never cancel, in containment; only recovery cancels.
OutboxStatus.title: OutboxStatus

ReadEntry.description: One entry of a read set: what an adapter observed, captured by the gateway (OTel ``ks.read_set``).

hash.description: Value hash of the version read.
hash.title: Hash

source.description:
v1.4 (B3-46): ``view`` (delivered in the tick's view) or ``tool`` (read by the adapter). Set by the gateway,
never by the agent. The default ``tool`` is the conservative reading of an untagged entry: the t0 walk
(ADR-05 §4) follows a suspect's self-reads only through ``tool`` entries.
source.title: Source

ReadEntry.title: ReadEntry

description: C3 value of an ``outbox:<id>`` object: an irreversible effect waiting to leave.

action_class.description: ``I1`` (containable) or ``I2`` (needs prior approval). Only I-class effects use the outbox.
action_class.title: Action Class

author.description: Principal whose action created the item (``gen_ai.agent.id``).
author.title: Author

created_seq.description: Record seq that created the item.
created_seq.title: Created Seq

dispatched_seq.description: Record seq of the dispatch; set iff status is dispatched.
dispatched_seq.title: Dispatched Seq

idempotency_key.description: Dedupe key from :func:`idempotency_key`; re-runs dedupe on this, never on nonce.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

lineage.description:
Read set of the creating action (from the record, never agent-declared); drives lineage hold. Same rule as
``Record.read_set`` (v1.4: :func:`check_read_set`).
lineage.title: Lineage

outbox_id.description: Gateway-assigned id; the object id is ``outbox:<outbox_id>``.
outbox_id.title: Outbox Id

payload_hash.description: Value hash of the payload; payload in the side store.
payload_hash.title: Payload Hash

release_tick.description:
Earliest tick it may be released: ``created_tick + H`` (H = ``hold_window_ticks``); with an early
hold (G3), when the lineage holds a sensitive-field version written at tick v,
``max(created_tick + H, v + 2H)``. Off at H = 0.
release_tick.title: Release Tick

title: OutboxItem
